# Corpus

Four buckets. Regenerated by `scripts/run_review.py`.

| Bucket | Count | Judged how |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `positive/` | 53 | compile + run; expected exit (and stdout when the program writes) |
| `negative/` | 46 | compile error, exit 2, diagnostic substring |
| `runtime/` | 12 | traps 120–123 or SIGSEGV 139 |
| `gap-probes/` | 4 | recorded, **not** judged — the spec does not dictate a result |

Gap probes are the programs to drop on `llrc` and on `reference/llri.py`:

- `uninitialized_local_after_untaken_let.llr`
- `let_self_reference.llr`
- `string_identity.llr`
- `empty_block_value.llr`
